title: Echo-Thread Examiner
text: Echo-Thread Examiner pulls pale threads from spoken names and tests them for weaknesses in the original. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: A name unravels more quietly than cloth.

defeatReward.text: Echo-Thread Examiner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
